canonicalPolicy: Exact sorted-key compact UTF8 JSON, no trailing newline. Format derived from accepted canonical fixture bytes, not a candidate serializer output.
opaqueIdentityPolicy: IDs bind only once to declared before paths, and declared fresh aliases to exact after paths after semantic checks. Fixed equality/freshness/live-path relations are authored here. No expected document, text, marks, selection, history count or map result is learned from runtime. History must restore/reuse declared IDs exactly. Private discarded intermediate split IDs are not constrained.
statePolicy: E0/H0 are captured after the specified authored selection and stored-marks setup on a fresh clean session (revision0, no units). Selection epoch increments iff final exact selection or stored marks changes, per dispatch.rs780–805; each recorded isolated document history publication advances history epoch1. Dirty remains true after edits/Undo because no saved-baseline canonical comparison is invoked; equality to initial content does not fake a saved acknowledgement.
queryPolicy: Availability/query must not mutate bytes/IDs/epochs/history or create a receipt. All apply oracles are separately valid from query.
sourceProofs: contracts/history/v1/vectors.json H01 exact scalar private inverse and IDs
crates/kwdj/src/edit_normalize.rs368–391 equal-metadata joins preserve left ID
crates/engine/src/tree.rs1271–1445 original endpoint admission, split-retaining prefix and sealed flat splice
crates/engine/src/dispatch.rs780–805 exact selection/stored change epoch rule
